title: Ectype mod stats file
description: The JSON document a mod ships under a resource name or file name ending in "ectype-stats.json", embedded in its plugin assembly or beside its DLL. Each stat's id is 0x20000000 | (the first four bytes of MD5(UTF-8 "ectype:stat:" + owner + "/" + name), little-endian, & 0x0FFFFFFF). Property names and string values are matched exactly. Unknown properties are ignored by the framework with a warning and refused here; every other rule here the framework enforces the same way.

owner.description: The namespace of every stat in the file, part of every id. "ectype" and "framework" are reserved. Never rename after shipping.

name.description: Part of the id; a manifest names the stat as "owner/name". Never rename after shipping.

kind.description: "field": an absolute number whose base is "default". "factor": a multiplier whose base is 1.

default.description: The base value. Required for a field; a factor's is 1. A number no float can hold refuses the whole file.

collection.description: Where the framework registers the stat: every player character's own collection, every player ship's own collection, or the session collection.

lowerIsBetter.description: True colours a reduction as a buff.

displayType.description: How a modifier on the stat reads in tooltips. Default "percentage" for a factor, "value" for a field.

iconFrom.description: A vanilla StatType name or framework stat name whose tooltip icon the stat borrows.
